---
name: Flag (review duty)
about: An issue, glitch, inconsistency, or improvement spotted while reviewing
title: "FLAG: "
labels: ["type: flag", "status: ready"]
---

**What I found:** (the problem or opportunity, with evidence — quote the doc/code/fact it contradicts)

**Where:** (link to the page, file, PR, or message)

**Why it matters:** (impact if we do nothing)

**Suggestion:** (proposed fix — or "needs decision" with the options as you see them)

**Severity:** stops work (also post to #blockers) / should fix / nice to have
